topics.title: Alert versus incident
topics.concept: A detection is a testable suspicion. An incident requires enough corroboration to justify a security response.
topics.scenario: An identity alert says impossible travel, but both sessions use the same registered laptop through an approved corporate VPN.
topics.pivot: Compare device ID, token session, MFA history and VPN egress before labeling compromise.
topics.trap: Country changes alone do not prove account takeover.
topics.hint: Group identity events by account, device and session, then sort in UTC.
workflow: Identify the affected identity, device or service and define the investigation time window in UTC.
Verify the source is collecting reliable events and look for a known-good record.
Compare device ID, token session, MFA history and VPN egress before labeling compromise.
Compare observed facts with normal authorized activity and explicitly record missing evidence.
Write a concise finding with evidence, confidence, impact and a safe next step.

check.question: In the situation described for “Alert versus incident”, what is the strongest immediate analyst action?
options: Treat the initial alert as confirmed compromise and isolate everything immediately.
Ignore the record because similar benign activity sometimes exists.
Compare device ID, token session, MFA history and VPN egress before labeling compromise.
check.explanation: Compare device ID, token session, MFA history and VPN egress before labeling compromise. A single signal does not establish scope or malicious intent. Country changes alone do not prove account takeover.

topics.concept: Severity describes potential technical harm; priority accounts for asset criticality, exposure, confidence and operational deadlines.
topics.scenario: A low-volume privileged login to the backup controller may outrank noisy workstation scans.
topics.pivot: Confirm business owner, privilege, sensitive system role and active damage.
topics.trap: A critical badge on a rule is not an automatic P1.
topics.hint: Write a one-sentence impact statement and list the evidence needed to change priority.

topics.trap: Listing indicators with no timeline leaves the receiving analyst guessing.
